connector.name: Azure DevOps (ADO)
connector.registryDescription: The MCP server for Azure DevOps, bringing the power of Azure DevOps directly to your agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.dev.azure.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the premierinc account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
